campaign: Integrated validation, GUI cleanup lane: validate, harden and simplify the HTML workbench
doctrine: GUI cleanup lane (overgo_gui_cleanup), branched from master 3a331e81 on 2026-09-22. Scope: validate, harden and simplify the embedded HTML workbench (internal/server/webui and the server contracts it calls). Capability freeze enforced by structure: no new model family, workflow, optimizer or orchestration framework; rows that need native audio, speech-document admission (master row speech-document-admission) or training-loop producers stay with their owning lanes and are not carried. Baseline measured at 3a331e81: every page acceptance passes and the screens walk captures 104 states at 2 viewports in 2 colour schemes with 0 layout findings, so the order is correctness of client contracts, stream and listener lifecycle, per-tab mount health, accessibility, consolidation, then style and the four GUI improvements that consume capabilities master already serves. Every layout or interaction change is reviewed in the browser pane at desktop and phone widths in both colour schemes before landing, and its acceptance is a browser leg or Go test that fails without the change; a consolidation that removes code holds a ratchet instead. A step's machine check is set with plan -setverify; a check whose real prerequisite cannot run records UNAVAILABLE rather than a pass. Preserve the conversation-first design: flat messages, lists and separators, no cards, reachable Send/Stop, one compact model selector, mobile drawer, settings on demand, status only for progress, failure or required action; keep the same-origin client, CSP and authenticated transport. Lane cycle: merge current master (never its plan.json) before each row when master has moved, re-plan from the merged tree, execute one row, gate. The lane plan never merges into master; publishing lane commits to master needs separate owner authorization. Bind read-only reference stores with OVERGO_SMOKE_REFERENCE_STORE and OVERGO_AUDIO_REFERENCE_STORE at C:/Users/jeffm/overgo/overgodb-store; the data root and browser output stay in this worktree.

items.title: Read the agent tool registry and agent session roots without paging the whole catalog

steps.title: Read the agent tool registry and agent session roots without paging the whole catalog
steps.rationale: Follow-up to webui-manifest-latency: /agent/tools (tool.registered.) and /agent/sessions (interaction/response/) still reach their alias roots through aliasNamesUnder, the paged catalog query that cost tens of seconds per call on the live store, so the Agent tab stalls when opened. Read each root from the documents it binds; keep the stale-registration report for a tool alias whose target no longer resolves to a manual.

items.title: Release every stream, poller and listener a tab opens, report or reconnect ended streams, and stop background polling while hidden

steps.title: Release every stream, poller and listener a tab opens, report or reconnect ended streams, and stop background polling while hidden
steps.rationale: Audit: mod/peers.js:164 discards the runtimeEvents unsubscribe (a leaked subscriber per mount, rendering into detached DOM, double evidence fetch); mod/inbox.js:51 opens its own /agents/stream for events the shared stream already carries and refetches per event; agent, automations, peers and inbox tabs go silently stale when a stream ends; boot.js:281 adds a visibilitychange listener per poller that is never removed and boot.js:276 rethrows inside a timer; the status probe refetches /catalog/models every 10 s even while hidden; navigator.clipboard.writeText rejects unhandled on insecure origins; failed key changes stack banners; dataset previews and history loads race without abort. Acceptance: the browser journey mounts and leaves each streaming tab repeatedly, the server-side stream count returns to baseline, an ended stream is reported or resumed, a hidden page issues no catalog probes and overgo.errors stays empty.

items.title: Prove every workspace tab mounts without an error banner or page error, and open gallery artifacts through the authenticated client

steps.title: Prove every workspace tab mounts without an error banner or page error, and open gallery artifacts through the authenticated client
steps.verify: go run ./cmd/webui-lane -run '^TestWebUIBrowser(Screens|ArtifactLinks)$' -require 'tab mount errors: 0' -require 'artifact links leg'
steps.rationale: Audit: the screens walk checks overgo.errors once at start and never per tab, and thirteen tabs (generation, runtime, datasets, export-jobs, runs, peers, compositions, artifacts, vocab, lens, states, tensors, api) have no other browser test; evaluations.js and training.js open /artifacts?id= in a new tab, a bearer route that answers 401 with a key configured, and composer.js wraps images in a link el() turns into a download. One overgo.contentURL replaces nine hand-built content URLs. Acceptance: the walk records banners and page errors per tab and the leg prints zero; with an API key set, gallery links open the artifact inside the workbench.

items.title: Give every workbench control an accessible name and make the layout audit refuse unlabelled controls

steps.title: Give every workbench control an accessible name and make the layout audit refuse unlabelled controls
steps.rationale: Audit: about 25 controls carry only a placeholder (agent, automations, artifacts, discovery, analyze_* layer and k fields, schema_form), boot.js:667 renders analysis field names as detached spans, and aria-label sits on role-less divs (conversation list, status dots) where it is ignored; status dots are colour and tooltip only. Acceptance: the audit gains an unlabelled-control fault kind measured at every captured state and viewport, and the leg reports zero. Inspect the changed tabs in the browser pane at desktop and phone widths.

items.title: Consolidate the workbench's repeated client helpers onto single owners and delete dead markup, exports and inputs

steps.title: Consolidate the workbench's repeated client helpers onto single owners and delete dead markup, exports and inputs
steps.rationale: Audit: 51 errorBanner(friendlyError(...)) sites beside an overgo.reporter only agent.js uses; /operations/cancel called from four modules; artifactLink defined twice (evaluations.js, training.js); getKey/setKey/invalidateModel/evidenceLine exported but used only in boot.js; index.html #tabs unused; three permanently disabled inputs in compositions.js; two separate @media (max-width:860px) blocks; mixed tab and space indentation in recipe.js and runtime.js; loading copy exposes route paths. Consolidation removes code, so the acceptance is a ratchet test that holds each helper to one owner and forbids the dead identifiers; the full page lane must still pass.
